subject: Private deployment security discovery — isolation options & evidence needs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Herrera <alex.h@healthnova.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment security discovery — isolation options & evidence needs

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call today, really helpful to understand HealthNova's constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of ask from your side:
- Confirm regulatory posture: HIPAA applicability and any related state-level requirements.
- High-level network topology for the workloads you want private (data flow, ingress/egress, third-party integrations).
- SOC 2 status and expected timing for Type II (if applicable).
- Whether an air-gapped on-prem option is required or a VPC-only private deployment is acceptable.

What we need from HealthNova (fast wins):
1) Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached template) — this covers SOC, encryption, logging, IAM, and incident response. If procurement prefers, we can intake answers directly in a spreadsheet or through your vendor portal.
2) A simple architecture sketch (single-slide PNG/PDF) showing where Redwood would sit relative to your EHR systems and any third-party connectors.
3) Any legal or procurement redlines that will affect our standard Private/On‑prem agreement (DocuSign link below once we have a baseline).

Attachments: [HealthNova_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx] — a short questionnaire to get the SOC/GDPR/HIPAA details.

Proposed timeline:
- Questionnaire returned: within 7 business days
- Technical deep-dive (45–60m): week of Jul 22 — happy to propose slots
- Draft mutual action plan + initial scope doc: 3 business days after deep-dive

If an air-gapped cadence is required, please flag that explicitly — we can outline the evidence path (physical controls, transport restrictions, export controls) separately.

Alex — can you confirm: (a) HIPAA applies and (b) who will own filling the questionnaire (procurement or security)? Also, can you attach a redacted version of your network sketch if you have one?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HealthNova_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx]

From: Alex Herrera <alex.h@healthnova.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment security discovery — isolation options & evidence needs

Jasmine — great to meet you and the team on Monday. Quick answers below and I've looped procurement on the questionnaire.

1) Regulatory: Yes, HIPAA applies to the data set in scope. We also have some EU citizens' data; GDPR controls will apply where relevant.
2) SOC: We have SOC 2 Type I completed (Sept 2028). We're targeting Type II for Oct 2029; I can share a redacted summary now.
3) Network sketch: attached is a simplified dataflow showing our EHR, FHIR adapter, and the proposed private endpoint location.
4) Deployment preference: Prefer VPC private deployment to start. Air-gapped on-prem will be considered only if we see inbound/outbound restrictions we can't accommodate with a private VPC.

Procurement (procurement@healthnova.com) will own the questionnaire. Expect a completed spreadsheet in ~5 business days. If security wants to do a separate intake, cc me and I'll coordinate.

Attachments: [HealthNova_network_sketch_20290715.png], [HealthNova_SOC_summary_redacted.pdf]

Thanks,
Alex Herrera
Director, IT Security | HealthNova

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Herrera <alex.h@healthnova.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment security discovery — isolation options & evidence needs

Alex — perfect, thanks for the SOC summary and the sketch. A couple of clarifying points and next actions from Redwood: 

A. Isolation & access model choices (we'll document these in the action plan):
- Private VPC (preferred starting point): Redwood deploys a private endpoint in your VPC via peering/VPN or PrivateLink. We manage the inference runtime but customer data never egresses to public internet.
- Dedicated on‑prem (air‑gapped option): full on‑prem appliance or image; no external connectivity; requires physical access windows for upgrades and on‑site support.

B. Evidence we will need for our compliance review (from your team):
- Redacted SOC 2 report or attestation (you provided summary — thank you).
- Network diagram with permitted ingress/egress IPs and any firewall ACLs.
- Data classification for the datasets in scope (PHI/PII flags).
- Legal procurement redlines if any.

C. Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Jul 22–24: Technical deep-dive (45m) to validate VPC connectivity options and secrets/KMS flows.
- Jul 26: Receive completed questionnaire from procurement.
- Jul 29: Redwood provides draft deployment runbook + checklist and a rough timeline for a POC.

D. Quick asks for the deep-dive: please confirm which of these network patterns matches your environment:
1) Outbound-only from your network to our private endpoint (Nat egress)
2) Routed VPC peering/PrivateLink into your VPC with customer-managed NAT/gateway
3) On‑prem air-gapped appliance (scheduled physical deploy)

If you can reply with 1/2/3 preference and procurement's expected date, we'll lock the deep-dive slot.

I've attached a short note outlining Redwood's private-deploy options for your security team: [Redwood_private-deploy-options.md].

Best,
Jasmine
[Attachment: Redwood_private-deploy-options.md]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Herrera <alex.h@healthnova.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment security discovery — isolation options & evidence needs

Alex / team — quick technical note ahead of the deep-dive. I'm Soojin from Redwood's infra team; I'll run the technical session. A few items we'll cover and, if possible, please have the network engineer join: 

- Secrets & key management: do you have a KMS (cloud or HSM) we can integrate for key rotation, or do we need to manage secrets in a customer-managed vault?
- KV/cache persistence: if you prefer VPC route, we need to validate whether your environment allows long-lived connections and TCP keepalive for our inference nodes.
- Logging/monitoring: we'll need to confirm acceptable telemetry (token-level logs are redacted by default; we can provide aggregated metrics).
- Maintenance windows & physical access policy (if air-gapped): required for on‑prem option — typical lead times and allowed vendors on site.

Proposed slots for the 45–60m technical deep-dive (all PDT):
- Tue Jul 23, 11:00–12:00
- Wed Jul 24, 09:00–10:00
- Thu Jul 25, 15:00–16:00

Please confirm which works. Also, procurement — if you can start the questionnaire intake, that will speed things up.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
